audit.why: Tricky matchup framing is right: Xerath out-ranges Swain hard levels 1-3, Swain flips it at 6 with R sustain plus E lockdown on the immobile Rite of the Arcane channel.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[0/1/2].side all read 'Skill' but content win[0/1/2] already say 'Xerath', and phases[4/6].side read 'Skill' while win[4/6] say 'Swain'. Five of seven rows disagree between the two layers.
audit.why: Content whys and spikes already correctly describe Xerath's screen-range poke dominance levels 1-3 and Swain's R-sustain/E turnaround at 6 and 2+ items — the full layer never caught up.
audit.corrected: Moved phases[0/1/2].side to 'Xerath' and phases[4/6].side to 'Swain', with matching rating shifts and rewritten .why text grounded in the kit (Q/W poke range, mana-limited artillery, R drain outsustaining chip, E stunning his immobile channel).

audit.why: Xerath's R Rite of the Arcane is a self-rooting channel interruptible by any CC — Swain's E Nevermove root cancels it, and the page already states this in spikes[1] and the late-game text.
48.54% at 1477 games is a near-even matchup leaning slightly Xerath, consistent with the TRICKY tag already on the page.
